task_type: supplier API normalization and public parity
requested_outcome: Make API-derived vacation and event content deterministic and loss-safe, then prove zero observed mismatches in a 10 plus 10 public sample and dated and undated search flows.
natural_destination: The public VII vacation and event place pages, cards, galleries and search results.
authorization_boundary: Local code, tests and release preparation are authorized. No production database, schema, supplier data, secrets, bindings, DNS or environment changes. Production publication requires the existing explicit release route and a clean duplicate-operation preflight.
no_applicable_lessons_reason: The project master plan and feedback standard named by AGENTS.md are absent, and no accepted lesson was loaded rather than inventing project truth.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A partial supplier response silently erases galleries, units or grouped facilities.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Reject content erosion before staging and keep the previously accepted generation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Focused tests prove place and child content loss is rejected while additive changes pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only one page is fixed while cards, searches or other places still use a different model.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Apply the guard at the shared supplier catalog publication boundary and sample both worlds and both search modes.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Ten vacation and ten event destinations plus dated and undated searches pass the same parity audit.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A green unit test is reported as a successful public release.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Require exact deployed-version evidence and public natural-destination checks after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Release IDs, source and tree, HTTP checks and public sample evidence are recorded.

sources.label: Existing accepted API normalization and catalog generation model
Observed 10 vacation and 10 event public sample

midpoint_gate.trigger: The shared catalog content-integrity guard and focused tests are complete.
checks: The active generation remains unchanged after rejection

attack_questions: Can an empty gallery replace a previously populated supplier gallery?
Can a missing room or room image disappear during a partial refresh?
Can dated search hide available places without an online price?
Can all tests pass while the deployed public version is still old?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public URLs for 10 vacation and 10 event places and dated and undated search checks on the deployed candidate.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused catalog guard tests, full suite, production build and public parity report.

effectiveness.baseline: The existing sync protects entity-count collapse but does not explicitly reject field-level content erosion for vacation and event details.
effectiveness.target: Zero observed errors in the final 20-place sample and both search modes, with content-loss fixtures blocked automatically.
